handoff:
HANDOFF -> code-reviewer
- What: Added managers/NetworkManager.gd autoload (not yet registered in project.godot) implementing host()/join()/disconnect_from_game() over ENetMultiplayerPeer, server-authoritative, with the exact signal/const contract required by MainMenu (TK-P0-03).
- Files: managers/NetworkManager.gd, tests/test_network_manager.gd (GUT-style, requires TK-PX-07 GUT install to execute)
- How to test (2 machines / 2 instances): 1) Producer adds `NetworkManager="*res://managers/NetworkManager.gd"` to project.godot [autoload]. 2) Instance A calls NetworkManager.host() -> expect log `[NET] server started on port 7777 (max clients: 8)`. 3) Instance B calls NetworkManager.join("<A's LAN IP>") -> expect `[NET] connecting to ...` on B and `[NET] peer joined: <id>` on A, `[NET] connection succeeded (client connected to host)` on B. 4) Close B -> expect `[NET] peer left: <id>` on A.
- Risks/limits: project.godot NOT edited per instructions (producer must add autoload line, see report). host()/join() input validation verified headlessly (invalid port / empty address both return ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER); live 2-instance connectivity still needs manual/QA verification under TK-P0-06. GUT unit test cannot run until GUT addon (TK-PX-07) is installed.

title: สร้าง TestArena.tscn (พื้น + วงกลม) และสลับ scene หลังเชื่อมต่อสำเร็จ
ทดสอบเปิดสองอินสแตนซ์ให้เชื่อมกันและพิมพ์ log ยืนยันการเชื่อมต่อ
handoff:
HANDOFF -> code-reviewer
- What: Added a headless, repeatable 2-instance network smoke test that launches one host + one client Godot process on localhost via NetworkManager.host()/join(), and asserts from their logs that the connection succeeded (automated proof for the Exit Gate item 'two instances connect + log confirms peer joined'). Only new files added; NetworkManager.gd/project.godot/MainMenu.gd untouched.
- Files: tests/net/net_smoke_peer.gd (standalone SceneTree `-s` entrypoint, role via --role=host|client), tests/net/run_net_smoke.sh (bash driver; GODOT_BIN env override, ubuntu-CI compatible)
- How to test (2 machines / 2 instances, manual GUI equivalent): Machine/Window A: MainMenu -> Host (port 7777). Machine/Window B: MainMenu -> Join 127.0.0.1:7777 (or A's LAN IP). Expect A's console: `[NET] peer joined: <id>`; B's console: `[NET] connection succeeded (client connected to host)`. Automated equivalent: `GODOT_BIN="C:/Tools/Godot/Godot_v4.7-stable_win64_console.exe" bash tests/net/run_net_smoke.sh` -> prints both logs + `NET SMOKE: PASS`. Ran locally 4x in a row, 4/4 PASS (see report for captured output).
- Risks/limits: Automated test proves localhost (2 processes, 1 machine) connectivity only; true 2-machine LAN test is still a human/QA follow-up per the card's note. Client-side has a fixed 1.5s post-connect grace period before quitting (found during testing: the client's own connection_succeeded fires before the host finishes its side of the handshake; quitting instantly tore down the socket before the host's peer_connected packet was received/processed) -- bounded and deterministic, not a flaky sleep. Not wired into CI (see report recommendation to producer/tools-devops). Logs are written to the OS temp dir, gitignored, never into the repo tree.

title: ทำ Tag detection: Area3D รอบเสือ ตรวจผู้เล่นที่เข้าใกล้
parked: AUTOMATION GATE GREEN, HUMAN 2-INSTANCE PENDING (2026-07-13). Host-authoritative Area3D proximity sensor as a plain Player-root component (TagDetectorComponent.gd + pure TagRules.gd), role-agnostic, RPC-free; feeds TK-P2-03. code-review APPROVE-WITH-NITS (no S0/S1/S2). architect APPROVED placement (sensor != ability; binding invariant: TagDetector stays RPC-free) — Ability_System_Design.md §2/§3/§4b + Change Log [0.39] amended. qa PASS own run: import clean, GUT 201/201 (+17 TagRules), net_smoke + spawn_probe + spawn_probe_together PASS (no Player.tscn spawn regression). RESUME = human 2-instance check (needs temp debug prints in _on_body_entered/_exited): (1) two players within 2m -> body_entered fires + tag_target_in_range(tagger,target) with correct peer ids; (2) HOST-ONLY EMIT holds (fires server=true on host, NOT on client); (3) leave range -> tag_target_left_range + get_candidates_in_range() empties; (4) despawn a peer in range -> no stale candidate, no crash on body.name (document whether left_range fires -> TK-P2-03 poll-vs-event); (5) floor not a candidate. Any server=true emit on client (2) or crash on despawn (4) = blocker. Followups: TK-P2-24 (headless probe, tools-devops, DONE), TK-P2-25 (code nits). tag_range_m=2.0 placeholder -> Phase-3 balance (designer). CLOSED (2026-07-14): human 2-instance test PASS 5/5 via temp debug prints in _on_body_entered/_exited + a temp DebugOverlay candidates line (both reverted after the test, GUT re-confirmed 201/201 clean). (a) in_range/left_range fire with correct peer ids both directions; (b) host-only-emit CONFIRMED (host is_server=true + signal fires, client is_server=false + signal silent); (c) leaving range -> left_range + candidates=0; (d) despawn a peer in range -> host does not crash, no stale candidate; (e) floor never a candidate. NOTE FOR TK-P2-03: log showed in_range/left_range re-firing repeatedly within the same second when a player stands right on the ~2m boundary (natural Area3D edge jitter) -- the Tag Sequence must guard against re-triggering off this (hysteresis / cooldown / a lock while a sequence is already running), or the Tiger could tag-lock rapid-fire on boundary standing.

title: ทำ Tag Sequence (state machine ย่อย): 1) เสือจับล็อกผู้เล่น 2) ทุ่มลงพื้น 3) เล่นเอฟเฟกต์กลายร่าง 4) ผู้เล่นที่ถูกทุ่มกลายเป็นเสือใหม่ 5) เสือเดิมกลับเป็นคน 6) เสือเดิมย้ายออกนอก Safe Circle 7) กลับสู่สถานะ Playing
notes: STARTED 2026-07-14 (TK-P2-02 human 2-instance PASS 5/5, unblocked). Scope decisions taken to unblock (flag for architect placement review, same pattern as TK-P2-02's sensor placement): (1) new minimal GameManager node (TestArena-scene-local, sibling to PlayerSpawner -- NOT an autoload, mirrors PlayerSpawner's own placement) owns ONLY the Tag Sequence + an internal 'sequence active' lock; the full WaitingRoom->Countdown->Playing->MatchEnd match SM is TK-P2-15 (later, separate card) -- do not build that here, step 7 'return to Playing' = clear the lock, not a global enum. (2) 'Tag' becomes a new TigerAbility (input_action &"tag", new InputMap action added to project.godot bound to the same left-mouse-button as kick, since Tiger/Outer catalogs are mutually exclusive per role) following the exact Kick pipeline (Ability_System_Design.md §4 walkthrough) -- host_validate reads TagDetectorComponent.get_candidates_in_range() + TagRules.nearest_candidate(), host_apply() is what starts the 7-step sequence on GameManager (steps 2-7 are consequences of a successful Tag activation, not separately player-triggered). (3) Safe Circle (step 6) has no boundary yet (TK-P2-06 still todo) -- stub as a placeholder exit point/direction, explicitly flagged non-final. (4) MANDATORY re-trigger guard from TK-P2-02's human-test observation: log showed tag_target_in_range/left_range re-firing repeatedly within the same second at the ~2m boundary (natural Area3D edge jitter) -- TagAbility.host_validate() must reject a new Tag while GameManager's sequence-active lock is set (cooldown ledger alone is not enough, since the lock must hold for the sequence's full duration, not just one cooldown window).

title: Late-join / late-connect after Match Start: refuse or route peers that connect (or click Join) after the host has started the match
note: From TK-P2-13 code-review (round1 finding4) + qa. Two reachable states once Start fires: (a) a peer connecting during the spawn barrier window is deferred by PlayerSpawner (_deferred_join_peers) but NEVER spawned -> connected-but-Player-less; (b) a peer connecting after the host has left the WaitingRoom lands in a WaitingRoom whose host counterpart is freed (its _rpc_client_hello targets /root/WaitingRoom on a host that isn't there -> dead empty roster, can never start), and PlayerSpawner._on_peer_connected would spawn a driverless ghost avatar for everyone. Decide + implement: either REFUSE joins after Start (host rejects/closes the lobby on match start) or properly ROUTE late joiners into the running match (spawn them cleanly, put them in the arena). Server-authoritative. Not an S1 in the happy path (guarded), but a correctness/UX gap that must close before the Phase 2 Exit Gate.
